title: “Tutto l'amore che ho” by Jovanotti
text: "Tutto l'amore che ho" is a song by Italian singer-songwriter Jovanotti. It was released on 3 December 2010 through Universal Music Italy as the lead single from his twelfth studio album Ora.

title: “Rolling in the Deep” by 17 January
text: "Rolling in the Deep" is a song by English singer-songwriter Adele from her second studio album, 21. It is the lead single and opening track on the album.

title: “Arriverà” by Modà featuring Emma
text: "Arriverà" is a song recorded by Italian pop rock group Modà and Italian singer Emma. It was released on 16 February 2011 through Ultrasuoni Records as the third single from the band's fourth studio album Viva i romantici.

title: “On the Floor” by 21 March
text: "On the Floor" is a song recorded by American singer Jennifer Lopez for her seventh studio album, Love?.

title: “Mr. Saxobeat” by 18 April
text: "Mr. Saxobeat" is a song by the Romanian singer Alexandra Stan, released on 12 September 2010 as the second single from her debut album, Saxobeats.

title: “Danza Kuduro” by 16 May
text: "Danza Kuduro" is a Spanish/Portuguese song by Puerto Rican recording artist Don Omar and Portuguese–French singer Lucenzo, from Don Omar's collaborative album Meet the Orphans. The song is an adaptation of Lucenzo's "Vem Dançar Kuduro", a Portuguese/English one.

title: “Shimbalaiê” by 25 July
text: "Shimbalaiê" is a song by Brazilian singer-songwriter Maria Gadú from her self-titled album Maria Gadú. The song was also included on the soundtrack of the soap opera Viver a Vida.

title: “Benvenuto” by 12 September
text: "Benvenuto" / "Bienvenido" is a song recorded by Italian singer Laura Pausini for her studio album Inedito. The song, produced by Paolo Carta, was written by Laura Pausini, Niccolò Agliardi and Paolo Carta.

title: “Someone Like You” by Adele
text: "Someone like You" is a song recorded by English singer-songwriter Adele. She and Dan Wilson wrote and produced the track for her second studio album, 21.

title: “Ai se eu te pego!” by 5 December
text: "Ai Se Eu Te Pego" is a 2008 song originally produced by Sharon Acioly and Antônio Dyggs. Although the first versions of the song were well known by the Brazilian Northeastern public, the version that become a national and international success was recorded by the sertanejo singer Michel Teló.
